scripts.clean:ports: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { if (process.platform === 'win32') { execSync('netstat -ano | findstr ":5173" | findstr "LISTENING"').toString().split('\n').forEach(line => { const pid = line.trim().split(/\s+/)[4]; if (pid) try { execSync(`taskkill /F /PID ${pid}`, { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch(e) {} }); execSync('netstat -ano | findstr ":5174" | findstr "LISTENING"').toString().split('\n').forEach(line => { const pid = line.trim().split(/\s+/)[4]; if (pid) try { execSync(`taskkill /F /PID ${pid}`, { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch(e) {} }); } else { execSync('lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 || true', { shell: '/bin/bash' }); execSync('lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 || true', { shell: '/bin/bash' }); } console.log('✅ 端口清理完成'); } catch(e) { console.log('✅ 端口已经空闲或清理完成'); }"
scripts.docs:build: vitepress build docs && vite build --config vite.config.docs-demo.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='docs/.vitepress/dist/demo';fs.mkdirSync(p+'/demo',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p+'/index.html',p+'/demo/index.html');"
scripts.lib:build: vite --config vite.config.lib.ts build && vite --config vite.config.iframe-bridge.ts build && vite --config vite.config.nuxt.ts build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('dist/vue-stack-tabs.css','dist/style.css');fs.copyFileSync('dist/src/lib/iframe-bridge.d.ts','dist/iframe-bridge.d.ts');fs.mkdirSync('dist/utils',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('dist/src/lib/utils/iframeBridge.d.ts','dist/utils/iframeBridge.d.ts');fs.mkdirSync('dist/nuxt',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('dist/src/lib/nuxt/module.d.ts','dist/nuxt/module.d.ts');fs.mkdirSync('dist/nuxt/runtime',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('dist/src/lib/nuxt/runtime/plugin.d.ts','dist/nuxt/runtime/plugin.d.ts');fs.copyFileSync('dist/nuxt/plugin.mjs','dist/nuxt/runtime/plugin.mjs')"
